mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for November 24, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Palestinian killed by Israeli fire east of Gaza's Deir al-Balah - WAFA Agency. Palestinian killed by Israeli fire east of Gaza's Deir al-Balah WAFA Agency GAZA, November 22, 2026 (WAFA) - A Palestinian man was killed by Israeli fire east of Deir al-Balah in the central Gaza Strip on Sunday evening. This was reported by WAFA. 2. Israeli air strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza. Naeem Abu Nahel, who had been in the post for two months, is among seven Palestinians reportedly killed in Israeli strikes on Tuesday. This was reported by BBC News. 3. Israeli air strike kills senior Hamas security official in Gaza. Naim Abu Nahl, 50, was killed in a crowded area while four others, including a Palestinian woman, were wounded. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 4. Gaza issues meningitis epidemic alert after steep rise in cases. Health ministry records 272 new infections in October, more than eight times the normal monthly rate Gaza's health ministry.
